items.sentence: We have already paid for the concert tickets.
items.zh: 我們已經付了演唱會門票的錢。

items.sentence: She has taught math at this school for years.
items.zh: 她在這所學校教數學很多年了。

items.sentence: I have not opened the letter from my friend yet.
items.zh: 朋友寄來的那封信我還沒拆開。

items.sentence: He has broken his glasses during the football game.
items.zh: 他在足球比賽中弄壞了他的眼鏡。

items.sentence: They have cleaned the whole house this morning.
items.zh: 他們今天早上把整間房子都打掃了。

items.sentence: We have planned a surprise party for Grandma.
items.zh: 我們為奶奶計畫了一場驚喜派對。

items.sentence: I have kept every postcard my aunt sent me.
items.zh: 我阿姨寄給我的每張明信片我都留著。

items.sentence: She has grown her own tomatoes this summer.
items.zh: 她今年夏天自己種了番茄。

items.sentence: The river has risen a lot after the heavy rain.
items.zh: 大雨過後河水漲了很多。

items.sentence: We have shared this bedroom since we were young.
items.zh: 我們從小就一起住這間臥室。

items.sentence: If you water the plants, they will grow faster.
items.zh: 如果你幫植物澆水，它們會長得更快。

items.sentence: If I finish early, I will help you with dinner.
items.zh: 如果我早點做完，我會幫你準備晚餐。

items.sentence: If the bus is late, we will take a taxi.
items.zh: 如果公車誤點，我們就搭計程車。

items.sentence: If you press this button, the machine will start.
items.zh: 如果你按這個按鈕，機器就會啟動。

items.sentence: If it snows tonight, school will be closed tomorrow.
items.zh: 如果今晚下雪，明天學校就會停課。

items.sentence: If I see your brother, I will give him the book.
items.zh: 如果我看到你弟弟，我會把書給他。

items.sentence: If we save enough, we will visit the ocean.
items.zh: 如果我們存夠錢，就會去看海。

items.sentence: If you tell the truth, people will trust you more.
items.zh: 如果你說實話，別人會更信任你。

items.sentence: If the sky stays clear, we will see the stars.
items.zh: 如果天空保持晴朗，我們就能看到星星。

items.sentence: If I feel tired, I will take a short break.
items.zh: 如果我覺得累，我會稍微休息一下。

items.sentence: If I lived by the sea, I would swim every day.
items.zh: 如果我住在海邊，我會每天游泳。

items.sentence: If she had a bike, she would ride to school.
items.zh: 如果她有腳踏車，她會騎車上學。

items.sentence: If I spoke French, I would travel across Europe.
items.zh: 如果我會說法文，我會遊遍歐洲。

items.sentence: If we had a bigger kitchen, we would cook together.
items.zh: 如果我們有更大的廚房，我們會一起做菜。

items.sentence: If he were kinder, more people would like him.
items.zh: 如果他更和善，會有更多人喜歡他。

items.sentence: If I owned a boat, I would sail around the island.
items.zh: 如果我有一艘船，我會繞著那座島航行。

items.sentence: If she practiced daily, she would play beautifully.
items.zh: 如果她每天練習，她會彈得很美。

items.sentence: If we lived closer, we would meet more often.
items.zh: 如果我們住得更近，我們會更常見面。

items.sentence: If I were rich, I would build a school for children.
items.zh: 如果我有錢，我會為孩子蓋一所學校。

items.sentence: If the room were brighter, I would read here.
items.zh: 如果房間更亮，我就會在這裡看書。

items.sentence: You must wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車時你必須戴安全帽。

items.sentence: We shouldn't waste food that others could eat.
items.zh: 我們不該浪費別人本可以吃的食物。

items.sentence: You can borrow my pencil until the class ends.
items.zh: 你可以借我的鉛筆用到下課。

items.sentence: We might visit the museum if it stops raining.
items.zh: 如果雨停了，我們也許會去博物館。

items.sentence: You must not touch the stove when it is hot.
items.zh: 爐子很燙的時候你絕對不能碰。

items.sentence: He can run faster than anyone in our class.
items.zh: 他跑得比我們班任何人都快。

items.sentence: We ought to thank the people who helped us.
items.zh: 我們應該感謝幫助過我們的人。

items.sentence: You could join the club if you have free time.
items.zh: 如果你有空，可以加入那個社團。

items.sentence: She might not come to the party after all.
items.zh: 她終究也許不會來派對了。

items.sentence: We must leave now or we will miss the train.
items.zh: 我們必須現在走，不然會錯過火車。

items.sentence: You should ask for help when a task feels hard.
items.zh: 當一件事覺得困難時，你應該尋求幫助。

items.sentence: I can't find the keys that I left on the table.
items.zh: 我找不到放在桌上的那串鑰匙。

items.sentence: We may need umbrellas if the clouds get darker.
items.zh: 如果雲變得更暗，我們也許需要雨傘。

items.sentence: The boy who broke the window said sorry quickly.
items.zh: 打破窗戶的那個男孩很快就道歉了。

items.sentence: This is the river where we often go fishing.
items.zh: 這就是我們常去釣魚的那條河。

items.sentence: The woman whose dog ran away looked worried.
items.zh: 那隻狗跑掉的女士看起來很擔心。

items.sentence: I know a shop that sells very cheap notebooks.
items.zh: 我知道一家賣很便宜筆記本的店。

items.sentence: The day when we met is easy to remember.
items.zh: 我們相遇的那天很容易記得。

items.sentence: She is the nurse who looked after my grandfather.
items.zh: 她就是照顧我爺爺的那位護理師。

items.sentence: The city where I was born is near the mountains.
items.zh: 我出生的那座城市在群山附近。

items.sentence: He bought a watch that glows in the dark.
items.zh: 他買了一支在黑暗中會發光的手錶。

items.sentence: The friend whose bag I borrowed is very generous.
items.zh: 我借了包包的那位朋友非常大方。

items.sentence: This is the park where my dad learned to skate.
items.zh: 這就是我爸爸學溜冰的那座公園。

items.sentence: The actor who played the king was really tall.
items.zh: 飾演國王的那位演員非常高。

items.sentence: I visited a village that had no cars at all.
items.zh: 我去過一個完全沒有車的村莊。

items.sentence: The reason why she left is still a mystery.
items.zh: 她離開的原因至今仍是個謎。

items.sentence: The baker whose bread we love moved to another town.
items.zh: 做出我們愛吃的麵包的師傅搬到別的鎮了。

items.sentence: This is the chair that my grandfather made by hand.
items.zh: 這就是我爺爺親手做的那張椅子。

items.sentence: The season when the leaves turn red is my favorite.
items.zh: 樹葉轉紅的那個季節是我的最愛。

items.sentence: She found a dog that had lost its way home.
items.zh: 她發現一隻迷路回不了家的狗。

items.sentence: He told me that he had already fed the cat.
items.zh: 他告訴我他已經餵過貓了。

items.sentence: She said that the train would leave at noon.
items.zh: 她說火車會在中午出發。

items.sentence: My mother said that dinner was almost ready.
items.zh: 我媽媽說晚餐快好了。

items.sentence: He explained that the bridge was closed for repairs.
items.zh: 他解釋說那座橋因維修而關閉了。

items.sentence: The guide said that the cave was perfectly safe.
items.zh: 導遊說那個洞穴非常安全。

items.sentence: She told us that she had never seen snow.
items.zh: 她告訴我們她從沒見過雪。

items.sentence: He asked me where I had left my umbrella.
items.zh: 他問我把雨傘放在哪裡了。

items.sentence: They said that the shop would open again soon.
items.zh: 他們說那家店很快會再開張。

items.sentence: The pilot announced that we would land early.
items.zh: 機長宣布我們會提早降落。

items.sentence: She told me that her sister had moved abroad.
items.zh: 她告訴我她姊姊搬到國外了。

items.sentence: He asked if I could lend him some money.
items.zh: 他問我能不能借他一些錢。

items.sentence: The coach said that the game had been postponed.
items.zh: 教練說比賽延期了。

items.sentence: My neighbor said that the power would return soon.
items.zh: 我鄰居說電力很快就會恢復。

items.sentence: She explained that the recipe needed fresh herbs.
items.zh: 她解釋說這道食譜需要新鮮的香草。

items.sentence: He told me that he had fixed the leaking tap.
items.zh: 他告訴我他已經修好漏水的水龍頭了。

items.sentence: The teacher said that our drawings were wonderful.
items.zh: 老師說我們的畫作很棒。

items.sentence: They told us that the path was quite steep.
items.zh: 他們告訴我們那條小路相當陡。

items.sentence: She asked me if I had enjoyed the long trip.
items.zh: 她問我是否享受這趟長途旅行。

items.sentence: I have been practicing the piano every evening.
items.zh: 我每天晚上都在練鋼琴。

items.sentence: We have been cleaning the garage all afternoon.
items.zh: 我們整個下午都在清理車庫。

items.sentence: She has been reading that novel for a week.
items.zh: 那本小說她已經讀了一個星期。

items.sentence: They have been building a treehouse in the yard.
items.zh: 他們一直在院子裡蓋一間樹屋。

items.sentence: I think honesty matters more than winning a game.
items.zh: 我認為誠實比贏一場比賽更重要。

items.sentence: We believe that small kind acts can help a lot.
items.zh: 我們相信小小的善舉能幫上很大的忙。

items.sentence: I feel happier whenever I spend time outdoors.
items.zh: 每當我待在戶外，就覺得更快樂。

items.sentence: She felt proud when she finished the whole race.
items.zh: 她跑完整場比賽時感到驕傲。

items.sentence: He was worried because the test was quite hard.
items.zh: 他很擔心，因為考試相當難。

items.sentence: We were excited to see the fireworks at night.
items.zh: 我們很興奮能在晚上看到煙火。

items.sentence: I am planning to write a letter to my old teacher.
items.zh: 我打算寫一封信給我以前的老師。

items.sentence: She is hoping to join the dance group next term.
items.zh: 她希望下學期能加入舞蹈團。

items.sentence: We are looking forward to the summer holidays.
items.zh: 我們很期待暑假的到來。

items.sentence: He is trying to learn ten new words every day.
items.zh: 他正試著每天學十個新單字。

items.sentence: Could you show me how this app actually works?
items.zh: 你可以示範這個應用程式到底怎麼運作嗎？

items.sentence: Would you mind opening the window for some air?
items.zh: 你介意打開窗戶透透氣嗎？

items.sentence: I wonder if the shop still sells those old maps.
items.zh: 我在想那家店是否還賣那些舊地圖。

items.sentence: We should decide soon, or the tickets will sell out.
items.zh: 我們應該快點決定，不然票會賣完。

items.sentence: I have made a list of everything we still need.
items.zh: 我列了一張我們還需要的所有東西的清單。

items.sentence: If you listen carefully, you will hear the birds.
items.zh: 如果你仔細聽，你會聽見鳥叫聲。

items.sentence: She said that the museum was free on Sundays.
items.zh: 她說博物館星期天免費。

items.sentence: The student who asked the question seemed curious.
items.zh: 提出那個問題的學生看起來很好奇。

items.sentence: If I knew the answer, I would tell you right away.
items.zh: 如果我知道答案，我會立刻告訴你。

items.sentence: If we had more money, we would buy a bigger tent.
items.zh: 如果我們有更多錢，我們會買一頂更大的帳篷。

items.sentence: We might stay home if the roads are still icy.
items.zh: 如果路面還結冰，我們也許會待在家。

items.sentence: He has worn the same lucky scarf to every match.
items.zh: 每場比賽他都戴同一條幸運圍巾。

items.sentence: You should save some of your pocket money each week.
items.zh: 你應該每週存下一些零用錢。

items.sentence: The house where we stayed had a lovely garden.
items.zh: 我們住過的那棟房子有個可愛的花園。

items.sentence: She told me that she would bring the snacks.
items.zh: 她告訴我她會帶點心來。

items.sentence: If you plant the seeds now, they will bloom in spring.
items.zh: 如果你現在播種，它們會在春天開花。

items.sentence: I have been helping my dad repair the old clock.
items.zh: 我一直在幫我爸爸修那座舊時鐘。

items.sentence: We could walk home if the weather stays dry.
items.zh: 如果天氣保持乾爽，我們可以走路回家。

items.sentence: The girl whose painting won looked very surprised.
items.zh: 畫作得獎的那個女孩看起來非常驚訝。

items.sentence: He said that he had planted a tree for each child.
items.zh: 他說他為每個孩子種了一棵樹。
